Who we are

About Akhawein Charity

Community work and development since 2009, serving the families who need it most across Egypt.

Our story

Accountable giving that protects human dignity

Akhawein Charity was founded in 2009 as an Egyptian community organisation dedicated to social solidarity. We meet the living, health and education needs of the most vulnerable with the highest standards of honesty and transparency.

We invest in culture, skills and people: fighting poverty, advancing education, improving health and preparing young people for today’s job market.

We believe lasting development needs honest, determined management centred on people, so we opened branches across several governorates. We work alongside the state, with its approval, as partners in raising the cultural, educational and living standards of our society.

Our principles

Vision, mission and values

Steady principles that make sure help reaches the right people, honestly and efficiently.

Our vision

To be Egypt’s most trusted and impactful community organisation in improving the lives of families in need, and in rooting a culture of sustainable, development-led charity.

Our mission

To offer families in need and orphans a complete social and humanitarian safety net, through effective programmes and full transparency that protect every person’s dignity.

Our values

Honesty and integrity with every pound, fairness in how help is shared, transparency and accountability, and speed in reaching urgent cases.

Governance

Governance and financial oversight

Our activities and accounts are regularly reviewed by the Ministry of Social Solidarity and a certified public accountant, so that zakat, sadaqah and donations reach their proper legal and religious purposes.
